ORIGINAL USMLE-STYLE PRACTICE

Asthma maintenance treatment: 3

A patient is prescribed a suitable budesonide-formoterol inhaler for scheduled daily doses and extra doses when symptoms develop, within a written plan. Which description correctly identifies this maintenance-and-reliever approach rather than assuming all combination inhalers are interchangeable?

  1. An inhaled corticosteroid-containing regimen
  2. Low-dose ICS-formoterol reliever in the preferred adult Track 1 pathway
  3. Check diagnosis, inhaler technique, adherence and exposures before stepping up
  4. An individualized written asthma action plan
  5. The same suitable ICS-formoterol inhaler for maintenance and relief
Answer and explanation

The same suitable ICS-formoterol inhaler for maintenance and relief

MART combines scheduled maintenance with as-needed doses of a suitable ICS-formoterol product; it does not apply to every ICS-LABA inhaler.

Option explanations

The same suitable ICS-formoterol inhaler for maintenance and relief: MART combines scheduled maintenance with as-needed doses of a suitable ICS-formoterol product; it does not apply to every ICS-LABA inhaler.

An inhaled corticosteroid-containing regimen: Anti-inflammatory treatment reduces exacerbation risk; SABA-only treatment is not recommended for adults with asthma. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.

Low-dose ICS-formoterol reliever in the preferred adult Track 1 pathway: GINA Track 1 uses an anti-inflammatory reliever; the maintenance component depends on the treatment step. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.

Check diagnosis, inhaler technique, adherence and exposures before stepping up: Correctable delivery and adherence problems may explain poor control without requiring an automatic dose increase. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.

An individualized written asthma action plan: A written plan explains usual treatment, recognition of deterioration, agreed medication changes and when to seek urgent help. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
